title: erigeron utahensis var. sparsifolius
intro: Erigeron utahensis var. sparsifolius, commonly known as a variety of Utah fleabane, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). The plant is used in traditional medicine, known for its health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help in soothing wounds, reducing fever, and alleviating respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Erigeron utahensis var. sparsifolius include its ability to act as an expectorant, helping to expel mucus from the lungs, and its antimicrobial properties, which aid in fighting infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include essential oils, flavonoids, and terpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
